source: vanilla GTA SA PC 1.0 US map models (objs/tobj/anim, HD, overlays and LODs excluded for the buckets): texel density = sqrt(uv area x texture pixels / world area), area-weighted per model, p50 per size bucket; prelight means of all night-coloured map vertices; face-light mapping of data/colgen/tex_surface.json

prelight.note: night colours are darker and warm (R > B), never blue: 50 % of night-coloured models are warm, 10 % cool

prop.summary: street prop or small static object

building.summary: building or large static piece (gets a LOD model)

interior_prop.summary: furniture or clutter inside an interior

pickup.summary: pickup icon (tiny, one sphere COL, no night colours)

overlay.summary: decal or overlay plane (alpha, draw last, no collision)

face_light.note: COL face light nibbles from the prelit brightness (0..255): low nibble day, high nibble night; 0 means ambient only (about 3x darker by day)

col_rule.note: vanilla map models up to 8 m carry no collision faces (col.mesh_faces p50 = 0 below 8 m): a box, a few boxes or one sphere; faces only for bigger or shaped models. kit.export applies this rule to the classes listed here; an explicit --col mode wins
